build_GemmaConfig: build a GemmaConfig with custom vocab size hidden size and attention heads for a Gemma model
create_GemmaFastRMSNorm: create a GemmaFastRMSNorm layer that loads weights from a prefix and performs full precision normalization
run_FlashGemmaAttention: run FlashGemmaAttention forward pass with query key value tensors and KV cache for prefill or decode
test_FlashGemmaLayer: test FlashGemmaLayer forward pass with hidden states residual rotary embeddings and attention outputs
